verdict.rationale: OpenCode is documented as open source and works with any LLM provider, so there is little lock-in to leave behind. Its headless server exposes an OpenAPI endpoint and a type-safe SDK for programmatic control, which implies a route to your data, but no evidence documents a dedicated data export. missing for 10: a documented export command or feature for sessions, config and history, a statement of which open formats are used or where data is stored, and independent confirmation that users can fully export their data and leave.
